title: Zinnia Company, single-state Form 940 with a refund

status.note: Composed offline (AtsScenarioComposeTest). Schema validation waits for the 2026v2.0 bundle.

summary: A single-state (Arizona) Form 940 for 2026. $4,000 of payments above the $7,000 wage base come off $200,000 of payments, leaving $196,000 of taxable FUTA wages and $1,176 of tax. Deposits of $2,886 produce a $1,710 overpayment, refunded.
tests: Line 1a single state (AZ), no Schedule A
Line 5 payments in excess of $7,000 flow through line 6 to line 7
Line 8 at the 0.006 net FUTA rate
Line 15a overpayment with 'Send a refund' on line 15b, no direct deposit
notes: The city prints as 'TuFVRQ' in the PDF text layer (broken font map); the rendered page reads Tucson. ZIP 85641 is copied as printed.

Element-name rulings: line 1a SingleStateCd (other candidates OneStateCd, StateAbbreviationCd), line 5 PaymentsExceedingWageBaseAmt (TotalExcessPaymentsAmt), line 13 TotalTaxDepositAmt from IRS941 (FUTATaxDepositedAmt), line 15 OverpaymentGrp/OverpaidAmt/RefundOverpaymentInd from IRS941 (OverpaymentAmt/RefundInd), lines 16a-d TaxLiabilityQtr1Amt..Qtr4Amt after IRS941 TaxLiabilityMonth1Amt (FirstQuarter...Amt), line 17 TotalTaxLiabilityAmt (TotalYearLiabilityAmt).
No balance due and no requested payment date, so no payment record.
Responsible Party Current Indicator: Yes (PDF p.1). The composer's constant IRSResponsiblePrtyInfoCurrInd=true matches.
Signature Option: 'Use the signature method applicable to you' (PDF p.1). Part 7 is blank; Pyramos signs with ReportingAgentPINGrp.

Part 6 third-party designee: neither Yes nor No is checked and no designee is named (form page 2). The composer's DiscussWithThirdPartyNoInd=X is the only consistent header choice, since no designee exists to report.
Amounts are written with cents (200000.00), as the PDF prints them and as the 941 schema types them (USDecimalAmountNNType). One transcription wrote whole dollars; overruled.
